# Dr. Baskaran — Raga Dental

> Best dentist and implantologist in Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu. 25+ years of clinical experience in dental implants, laser dentistry, and digital dentistry at Raga Dental — a 7,000 sq.ft advanced dental center serving patients from India, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand.

Dr. Baskaran is trained at New York University (NYU) and Unicamillus University, Italy. He is an early adopter of navigation-guided and semi-robotic implant systems and a pioneer of laser dentistry in South Tamil Nadu.
